parsed.notes:
Minimum qualifications are required; Preferred qualifications are nice_to_have.
Read 'reinforced learning' as reinforcement learning.
The parenthetical deep-learning and reinforced-learning list has no explicit alternative marker; both are labeled without an alternative group.
Vertex AI Agent Builder is a distinct product without a taxonomy entry; it is the third framework alternative in group 2. Standalone Vertex AI is separately preferred, not a required parent inferred from Agent Builder.
Star Schema and Data Vault collapse into data-modeling under the taxonomy aliases.
Testing is required because the minimum-qualification mention overrides the preferred automated-testing mention.
Financial-services and regulatory knowledge are excluded as domain knowledge. Data residency and encryption are retained as unmapped technical requirements rather than adding an unnamed broad security skill.
Technologies and practices appearing only in the title, company description, or responsibilities, including GCP, CI/CD, IaC, and Terraform, are not labeled.
